title: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer

citation.text: Screening paraphrase: identify the manufacturer, different packer and importer as applicable, with required addresses; category-specific provisions may govern.

messages.pass: A manufacturer/packer address candidate was located; party roles and postal completeness require review.
messages.violation: The package does not carry the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer. A brand name alone does not satisfy Rule 6(1)(a).
messages.inconclusive: A manufacturer declaration was located but the address could not be read with confidence.
